title: Out My Window — Spatial Facade & Window Matrix
subtitle: Navigating exterior apartment facades into individual domestic rooms and memories
lineage: Lineage: Katerina Cizek, HIGHRISE / Out My Window (2010) · Supporting: SCION 097 (Welcome to Pine Point), SCION 098 (Bear 71)
theorem: Treat an urban apartment facade as an inspectable spatial index: move from the exterior grid of windows into individual domestic interiors, then hold four windows simultaneously in a spatial matrix without collapsing their separate lives.
boundary_note: Demonstrates the linear proof path of the interactive Spatial Window Matrix (`SCION 095–100`), preserving each room's distinct archival source.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #05 (t=17.80s-23.00s): `34a8fd98` cut at 3.1s from the parlor television to a studio camera.
Seg #06 (t=23.00s-28.20s): `780c159d` cut at 2.2s inside the living room.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Replaced Seg #05 and Seg #06 with verified cut-free domestic interior rooms `b2e97ba8` (`Something New From Something Old`, `0.2s-5.4s`) and `8f806ff1` (`Speaking of Rubber`, `0.5s-5.7s`) so all 4 spatial window nodes and the closing 4-window matrix play continuously without cuts.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Use `c77d3a98` (exterior facade), `a4ab6a4c` (1922 window), `cd47717f` (1938 child at window), `b2e97ba8` (1958 living room), and `8f806ff1` (1951 parlor).
